title: Flock Policy Compliance - West Bloomfield MI (West Bloomfield Police Department)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Michigan Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Please provide existing records of completed audits or compliance reviews of Flock Safety ALPR systems used by or for West Bloomfield, for January 1 through October 31, 2026, including:

1. Completed audit reports, review checklists, or summaries documenting review of searches, search purposes or case numbers, user access, or external agency sharing.
2. Findings of policy violations or other exceptions identified through those reviews.
3. Records documenting corrective action or resolution of those findings.

This includes responsive records maintained by the West Bloomfield Township or Police Department concerning reviews performed by the Oakland County Sheriff’s Office on West Bloomfield's behalf. This request seeks existing records and does not ask West Bloomfield Township or Police Department to conduct a new audit or create a report.

Please provide records electronically and on a rolling basis. If no responsive records are located for an item, please indicate that in the response. If any portion is withheld or redacted, please identify the applicable statutory exemption. Please advise me before incurring substantial charges.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Scott Gifford

communications.subject: Michigan Freedom of Information Act Request: Flock Audit West Bloomfield MI
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Michigan Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Under the Michigan Freedom of Information Act, I request the following records concerning West Bloomfield's use of Flock Safety:

1. Organization Audit Log
The complete Flock Organization Audit Log for the period 2026-07-01 through 2026-10-31

2. Network Audit Log
The complete Flock Network Audit Log for the period 2026-07-01 through 2026-10-31

These records may be available through the Flock administrative dashboard under Insights. Flock documentation states that customers may download these audit logs as spreadsheets in 31-day increments and recommends contacting Flock customer support for assistance with periods longer than six months.

Please provide the records in their original electronic format (CSV, Excel, or other native spreadsheet export), preserving all fields/columns contained in the original export, rather than converting the records to PDF.

If any field or portion of a record is withheld or redacted, please identify the specific statutory exemption relied upon for that withholding.

If retrieving the entire requested period would result in substantial cost or delay, please provide the readily available portions first and advise me before incurring substantial charges.

3. Shared Networks Export
This is a request under the Michigan Freedom of Information Act for the current Flock Safety Network Sharing or Shared Networks export for West Bloomfield, preferably the original SharedNetworks.csv or equivalent native electronic export. This is the Flock record showing organizations or networks sharing data with West Bloomfield and organizations or networks with which West Bloomfield shares data. Please provide the original electronic file generated by Flock rather than converting it to PDF or reformatting it. If any portion is withheld or redacted, please identify the applicable statutory exemption.

4. Administrative Event Log
This is a request under the Michigan Freedom of Information Act for West Bloomfield's Flock Safety Event Log. Please provide the available Event Log in its original electronic CSV or other native export format, including all fields contained in the export, for dates 2026-01-01 to the 2026-10-31 (2026 year-to-date). The requested record is the Flock administrative event log recording actions such as changes to hotlists, network sharing, users or roles, cameras, or other system administration. Please provide the original electronic file generated by Flock rather than converting it to PDF or reformatting it. If any portion is withheld or redacted, please identify the applicable statutory exemption.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Scott Gifford
